model_settings.value: fMRI analyses used FSL 5.0.9; whole-brain voxel-wise mixed-effects analyses treated participants as random effects. Time-series models used linear modeling with local autocorrelation correction and high-pass temporal filtering. Runs within sessions and abstinence scanning days were combined with fixed-effects models; smoking effects were first estimated with subject-level fixed-effects pairwise comparisons and then submitted to group-level random-effects analyses using FLAME1. Robust outlier deweighting was applied, and motion parameters and sex were included as covariates of no interest.
